fullDescription: WorkChain is a refined grunge protocol style guide designed for high-impact industrial or fintech applications. It combines punk rock minimalism with brutalist UI elements, utilizing a #F0EAD6 paper background, #1A1A1A deep black, and #DC143C crimson accents. The aesthetic features distressed typography, halftone textures, and jittery micro-interactions that evoke a 'machine-room' or 'underground manual' feel. Ideal for Web3 platforms, developer tools, or edgy creative agencies seeking an analog-digital hybrid look with high-contrast readability and asymmetric layouts.

structured.summary: A refined brutalist design system with grunge textures, monospaced utility fonts, and high-energy motion. It uses a high-contrast 'paper and ink' color palette with distressed edge effects and intentional mechanical glitches.

style.description: The style is characterized by a 'Punk Rock Minimalism' energy. It relies on monospaced typography (JetBrains Mono) for utility and heavy grotesk fonts (Cabinet Grotesk) for impact. Key visual markers include solid block shadows (no blur), 2-4px heavy borders, halftone dot patterns, and 'torn paper' clip-paths. Animations are non-linear, using 'step-end' curves to mimic mechanical jitter and screen flicker.
style.prompt: Create a visual style based on a 'Refined Grunge' aesthetic. Palette: Paper (#F0EAD6), Black (#1A1A1A), Crimson (#DC143C), and Gold (#C5A945). Typography: Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' (900 weight, uppercase, tracking -0.05em) for hero headlines and 'JetBrains Mono' (400, 700) for all body and UI text. UI elements should feature 4px solid black borders and 8px solid block shadows (offset: 8px 8px 0px #1A1A1A). Incorporate a global 10% opacity SVG fractal noise overlay. Use a halftone pattern (radial-gradient of #1A1A1A 1px to transparent, size 6px 6px) on secondary backgrounds. Implement a 'torn-edge' clip-path for cards and hero images using a complex multi-point polygon (0% 1%, 10% 0%, 20% 1%... 100% 99%). Animation style: 'jitter' (translate -1px, rotate -0.5deg) and 'flicker' (opacity 0.98 to 1.0) using step-end timing functions for a jerky, analog feel. Headline text should have a 'distressed' effect using a 2s step-end glitch on text-shadow (#DC143C and #C5A945).

layout_and_structure.description: The layout is modular and section-heavy, utilizing high-contrast dividers and asymmetric rotations to create a dynamic flow. It features a fixed utility header and a horizontal scrolling marquee for real-time status updates.

prompts.partPt: Menu do Topo & Menu do Topo
prompts.prompt: Design a fixed top header (height: 48px) in #DC143C crimson with a 4px black bottom border. Inside, place a continuous marquee of monospaced text in #F0EAD6. Below this, a primary navigation layer with a logo container: 4px black border, #C5A945 shadow, and uppercase black-box lettering. Use a search bar with a #1A1A1A 4px border and a solid block 'FIND' button.

Create a split-grid layout. The left side features massive uppercase headlines with 'text-distressed' glitch animations. Below the headline, place a descriptive block with a #1A1A1A background, #F0EAD6 text, and a 1.5-degree clockwise rotation. The right side contains a 'torn-edge' image container with a grayscale/contrast filter and a halftone overlay. Include a floating 'Trust Badge' (rotated -4 degrees) with a solid black shadow.

A full-width horizontal bar with a #1A1A1A background. Place small, uppercase monospaced filter buttons with white backgrounds and 2px black borders. Use a #C5A945 accent color for active or highlighted filters. High contrast is mandatory.

A 3-column grid of 'Gig Cards'. Each card has a 'torn-edge' clip-path, a 2px black border, and an 8px solid black block shadow. Images inside cards should have a grayscale/high-contrast filter that reverts to color on hover. Use 10px uppercase monospaced tags for categories and large font-weight for pricing. Include a user-info footer inside the card with a thick top border separator.

A dark-themed section (#1A1A1A) featuring a 4-step card layout. Each card should be slightly rotated (between -2 and 2 degrees) to create a 'scattered paper' look. Cards use #F0EAD6 background with distinct accent borders (#DC143C or #C5A945) and matching block shadows.

High-density information layout in #1A1A1A. Include a primary logo badge with a -2 degree rotation and a 2px white border. Organize links into a 3-column grid with 0.2em letter spacing. Add a 'System Log' section with 8px font-size monospaced text at 20% opacity for technical aesthetic.

special_ui_components.description: High-impact button with a constant mechanical vibration effect.
special_ui_components.prompt: Apply a 'jitter' animation (0.5s duration, step-end) to a button with #DC143C background, white text, and a 4px black border. The button must have a 6px solid black block shadow. On hover, the shadow should disappear (translate 4px 4px) to simulate a physical press.

special_ui_components.description: Image wrapper that looks like a piece of paper ripped from a notebook.
special_ui_components.prompt: Apply a CSS clip-path polygon with at least 20 anchor points along the top and bottom edges to create a jagged 'ripped' look. Use filter: grayscale(0.6) contrast(1.2) and a mix-blend-mode: multiply on the image. Overlay a halftone pattern (dot grid) at 20% opacity.

special_ui_components.description: Typography that appears to be glitching or printed poorly.
special_ui_components.prompt: Apply an infinite 2s step-end animation to text-shadow. At 0% and 100%, shadow is 2px 2px #DC143C. At 50%, shadow is -1px -1px #C5A945. Ensure 'Cabinet Grotesk' font is used with tracking-tighter.
